discrepancy.note: Ingersoll wishes Christ had reversed the saying, arguing a genuine gospel of peace would have averted centuries of religious cruelty.

quotes.text: Would it not have been far better had he said: "I come not to bring a sword, but peace"? Would not this have saved countless cruelties and countless lives?
quotes.attr: Robert G. Ingersoll (d. 1899), The Christian Religion, pt. III (1881), repr. Works, Vol. VI (Dresden Edition, 1900), on Matthew 10:34.

sides.snippet: Blessed are the peacemakers, For they shall be called children of God.
sides.verseText: Blessed are the peacemakers, For they shall be called children of God.

sides.snippet: \"Don't think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn't come to send peace, but a sword.
